@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+name: Testing
+on:
+- pull_request
+
+jobs:
+  pytest:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - name: Set up Python
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.9'
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: |
+          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
+          pip install .
+      - name: Test with pytest
+        run: |
+          pip install pytest
+          pytest tests/
